stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

title.zh: 集中照护期间预防交叉污染

summary.en: A day-shift nurse on a medical-surgical unit is caring for four adjacent clients: Client A with Clostridioides difficile infection on contact precautions, Client B with community-acquired pneumonia on standard precautions, Client C with a draining MRSA pressure injury on contact precautions, and Client D with smear-positive pulmonary TB in a functioning airborne infection isolation room. The nurse must model safe practice for a nursing student, teach visitors, and contain several infection-control breaches during the shift.
summary.zh: 一名日班护士在内外科病区照护四名相邻病房的患者：A 患者为艰难梭菌感染并执行接触隔离，B 患者为社区获得性肺炎并执行标准预防，C 患者有引流性 MRSA 3期压力性损伤并执行接触隔离，D 患者为痰涂片阳性肺结核并住在功能正常的空气传播感染隔离病房。护士需要为护生示范正确做法，教育探视者，并在班次中控制多项感染控制漏洞。

content.en:
Standing rules at each doorway and reviewed at shift huddle:
1. Alcohol-based hand rub (ABHR) is the default hand-hygiene method except when hands are visibly soiled or the client has a known or suspected spore-forming organism; then soap and water is required.
2. Dedicated or single-use equipment is required for clients on contact precautions. If a device must be shared, clean visible soil, disinfect with an appropriate agent, and allow the manufacturer-specified wet-contact time before the device enters the next room.
3. PPE is donned outside the room and doffed inside the room, gloves first and then gown, before exiting; perform hand hygiene immediately after removal.
4. Visitors are offered a precautions orientation at the first visit of each shift, including hand hygiene and required PPE.
5. Soiled linen from any isolation room is placed in a water-soluble inner bag and then into a labeled outer bag at the point of use.
content.zh:
各病房门口张贴并在交班小会上复习的常规制度：
1. 酒精类手消毒剂（ABHR）为默认手卫生方式；但手部明显污染或患者有已知/疑似产孢子病原体时，必须使用肥皂和清水洗手。
2. 接触隔离患者需使用专用或一次性设备。如设备必须共用，应先清除可见污物，再用合适消毒剂消毒，并达到厂家规定的湿接触时间后，才能进入下一间病房。
3. PPE 在病房外穿戴；离开前在病房内脱除，先脱手套再脱隔离衣；脱除后立即进行手卫生。
4. 探视者在每个班次首次探视时接受隔离预防指导，包括手卫生和所需 PPE。
5. 任何隔离病房的污染布草应在使用地点先放入水溶性内袋，再放入有标识的外袋。

content.en:
Client A, Room 12: 71-year-old post-op day 2 after right hemicolectomy. Six watery stools overnight; stool PCR positive for Clostridioides difficile at 0545. Contact precautions. Dedicated thermometer and blood-pressure cuff are in the room. Last void 7 hours ago; bladder scan ordered.
Client B, Room 14: 58-year-old with community-acquired pneumonia on standard precautions only. Oxygen by nasal cannula at 3 L/min; SpO2 93-94%. Suprapubic fullness; bladder scan ordered after Client A.
Client C, Room 16: 44-year-old with a large stage 3 sacral pressure injury, culture-positive for MRSA, open and draining through the dressing. Contact precautions. Dedicated stethoscope and blood-pressure cuff are in the room. Daughter has been helping reposition him.
Client D, Room 18: 29-year-old with confirmed pulmonary TB, sputum AFB smear positive, in a negative-pressure AIIR with green indicator light. Airborne plus standard precautions. Mother is at bedside.
content.zh:
A 患者，12房：71岁，右半结肠切除术后第2天。夜间水样便6次；0545 粪便 PCR 艰难梭菌阳性。执行接触隔离。房内有专用体温计和血压袖带。7小时未排尿，已医嘱膀胱扫描。
B 患者，14房：58岁，社区获得性肺炎，仅执行标准预防。鼻导管吸氧 3 L/min，SpO2 93–94%。诉耻骨上胀满；计划在 A 患者之后进行膀胱扫描。
C 患者，16房：44岁，骶尾部大型 3期压力性损伤，培养 MRSA 阳性，伤口开放且敷料有引流渗出。执行接触隔离。房内有专用听诊器和血压袖带。女儿一直协助翻身。
D 患者，18房：29岁，确诊肺结核，痰 AFB 涂片阳性，住在负压 AIIR，指示灯为绿色。执行空气传播隔离加标准预防。母亲在床旁。

title.en: Stage 1 — 0700 to 0900: shift organization and first rounds
title.zh: 阶段1 — 0700至0900：安排班次并首次查房

content.en: While the nurse is assessing Client A while wearing gown and gloves after soap-and-water hand hygiene, a nursing student steps into Room 12 wearing gloves but no gown. The student uses Client A's dedicated blood-pressure cuff, removes her gloves inside the room, and then touches the door handle with bare, unwashed hands. The nurse stops the student before she exits, directs soap-and-water hand hygiene, and arranges door-handle disinfection.
content.zh: 护士在完成肥皂和清水洗手并穿戴隔离衣和手套后，正在评估 A 患者。此时护生进入12房，只戴手套、未穿隔离衣。护生使用 A 患者的专用血压袖带，在房内脱下手套，然后用未清洁的裸手触碰门把手。护士在护生离开前立即制止，指导其用肥皂和清水洗手，并安排对门把手消毒。

content.en: At 0745, the nurse uses the portable bladder scanner on Client A; post-void residual is 410 mL, and the provider is notified. The scanner is also needed for Client B, who is on standard precautions. At 0800, Client C's daughter is in Room 16 in street clothes with no gown or gloves. She has been repositioning her father and says, "I've been coming every day — nobody told me I needed to put anything on." Client C's dressing is saturated and due for change.
content.zh: 0745，护士为 A 患者使用便携式膀胱扫描仪；残余尿量为 410 mL，已通知医务人员。该扫描仪随后还需用于仅执行标准预防的 B 患者。0800，C 患者女儿在16房，穿普通衣服，未穿隔离衣、未戴手套。她一直协助父亲翻身，并说：“我每天都来——没人告诉我需要穿戴什么。” C 患者敷料已被渗液浸透，需更换。

content.en:
0915: Client D's mother asks at the nurses' station whether she can take her daughter outside in a wheelchair for ten minutes of fresh air. The mother is not wearing a mask.
0945: During Client C's wound dressing change, the nurse notices Client C's dedicated stethoscope sitting on the clean-utility-room counter next to the clean supply cart. A housekeeper reports another staff member carried it out of Room 16 about 20 minutes earlier.
1030: Client A has another large watery stool. While the nurse is gowned and gloved in Room 12, soiled linens are bundled into a standard linen bag instead of a water-soluble inner bag and labeled outer bag. The student asks whether this matters.
1100: Client B's wife arrives, stops at Room 12's open doorway, sees the contact-precautions sign, and asks if she should worry because her husband is next door.
content.zh:
0915：D 患者母亲在护士站询问，能否用轮椅带女儿到室外呼吸10分钟新鲜空气。母亲未戴口罩。
0945：护士为 C 患者更换伤口敷料时，发现 C 患者的专用听诊器放在清洁用物间柜台上，靠近清洁物品车。保洁人员说约20分钟前有另一名工作人员把它从16房拿出并放在那里。
1030：A 患者再次大量水样便。护士在12房内穿戴隔离衣和手套协助清洁时，污染布草被装入普通布草袋，而不是先放入水溶性内袋再放入有标识外袋。护生询问这是否重要。
1100：B 患者妻子到达，停在12房开着的门口，看到接触隔离标识，询问丈夫就在隔壁是否需要担心。

content.en:
Client A: T 38.4 C, HR 110, BP 100/58; two additional large watery stools since 0900, intake 750 mL IV, output about 1,100 mL; potassium 3.1 mEq/L, creatinine 1.5 mg/dL.
Client B: stable; post-void residual 45 mL; preliminary sputum culture Streptococcus pneumoniae susceptible to ceftriaxone.
Client C: dressing changed; wound appearance unchanged; vancomycin monitoring managed by pharmacy.
Client D: remains in AIIR; morning sputum AFB smear still positive (2+); mother remains at bedside and the outdoor-trip request has not yet been addressed.
content.zh:
A 患者：T 101.1 °F (38.4 °C)，HR 110，BP 100/58；0900后又有2次大量水样便，IV 入量 750 mL，尿液和粪便总出量约 1,100 mL；血钾 3.1 mEq/L，肌酐 1.5 mg/dL。
B 患者：情况稳定；残余尿量 45 mL；痰培养初步为肺炎链球菌，对头孢曲松敏感。
C 患者：敷料已更换；伤口外观无变化；万古霉素监测由药房按制度管理。
D 患者：仍在 AIIR；晨痰 AFB 涂片仍阳性（2+）；母亲仍在床旁，外出请求尚未处理。

title.en: Stage 3 — 1200 to 1500: resolution, teaching, and evaluation
title.zh: 阶段3 — 1200至1500：处理、教学与评价

content.en:
1215: The nurse debriefs the student about the Room 12 entry without a gown, missed hand hygiene after glove removal, door-handle contact, the linen-bagging error, and the stethoscope found in the clean utility room.
1230: The charge nurse asks which identified breach posed the greatest cross-contamination risk to other clients and why.
1300: Client D's repeat sputum AFB smear remains positive (2+); the provider confirms airborne precautions and AIIR must continue. The nurse teaches the patient and mother that non-essential trips outside the AIIR are not permitted while smear-positive; a surgical mask is used on the patient only for medically necessary transport, and visitors follow the facility airborne-precautions policy with instruction and offering of an N95 respirator.
End of shift: Client C's daughter correctly demonstrates gown and glove donning and doffing. The contaminated stethoscope is retrieved; clean-utility surfaces it may have touched are disinfected; potentially contaminated nearby supplies are removed or handled per policy; the stethoscope is disinfected with full wet-contact time and returned to Room 16. Client A's CDI diarrhea continues; contact precautions remain. Client D remains smear-positive in AIIR. The student requires follow-up education and supervised return demonstration.
content.zh:
1215：护士与护生重点复盘12房未穿隔离衣进入、脱手套后未手卫生、触碰门把手、布草装袋错误，以及在清洁用物间发现听诊器的问题。
1230：责任护士询问已发现的哪些漏洞对其他患者造成最大的交叉污染风险，以及原因。
1300：D 患者复查痰 AFB 涂片仍阳性（2+）；医务人员确认必须继续空气传播隔离和 AIIR。护士向患者和母亲解释：涂片阳性期间不得因非必要原因离开 AIIR；只有医学必要转运时才给患者戴外科口罩；探视者需遵循机构空气传播隔离探视政策，包括指导并提供 N95 呼吸防护口罩。
班末：C 患者女儿能正确回示隔离衣和手套的穿脱。污染听诊器已取回；其可能接触的清洁用物间表面已消毒；附近可能污染的物品已按制度移除或处理；听诊器完成全程湿接触时间消毒后送回16房。A 患者 CDI 腹泻仍持续，继续接触隔离。D 患者仍为涂片阳性并留在 AIIR。护生需要后续教育和受监督回示。

stem.en: Stage 1: Put the steps in the correct order for handling the portable bladder scanner after use on Client A before taking it to Client B.
stem.zh: 阶段1：将为 A 患者使用便携式膀胱扫描仪后、带去 B 患者房间前的处理步骤按正确顺序排列。

stem.en: Stage 3: Which statements show an accurate evaluation of whether the infection-control interventions were effective? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 阶段3：哪些陈述能准确评价感染控制干预是否有效？选择所有适用项。

stem.en: Stage 1: Classify each nursing-student behavior in Client A's Clostridioides difficile room.
stem.zh: 阶段1：请判断护生在 A 患者艰难梭菌病房中的每项行为。

rows.en: Entering the contact-precautions room wearing gloves but no gown
rows.zh: 进入接触隔离病房时只戴手套、未穿隔离衣

rows.en: Using the blood-pressure cuff dedicated to Room 12
rows.zh: 使用12房专用的血压袖带

rows.en: Removing gloves and failing to perform hand hygiene immediately afterward
rows.zh: 脱下手套后未立即进行手卫生

rows.en: Touching the door handle with bare, unwashed hands after client contact
rows.zh: 接触患者后用未清洁的裸手触碰门把手

correct.en: Contact precautions require gown and gloves before room entry. The dedicated cuff belongs in Room 12 and is appropriate to use. The major failures are missing the gown, missing immediate hand hygiene after glove removal, and touching a shared surface with contaminated bare hands; in a C. difficile room, the required hand-hygiene method is soap and water.
correct.zh: 接触隔离要求进入病房前穿隔离衣并戴手套。12房专用血压袖带可在该房内使用。主要问题是未穿隔离衣、脱手套后未立即手卫生，以及用污染的裸手触碰共用表面；在艰难梭菌病房，所需手卫生方式为肥皂和清水洗手。

byChoice.en: This is a breach because clothing can be contaminated during contact-precautions care; gloves alone are not enough.
byChoice.zh: 这是违规，因为接触隔离照护中衣物可能被污染；仅戴手套不够。

byChoice.en: This is not a breach because the cuff is dedicated to Client A's room and is not being moved to another client.
byChoice.zh: 这不是违规，因为该袖带专用于 A 患者房间，并未拿给其他患者使用。

byChoice.en: This is a breach because organisms can be transferred during glove removal; hand hygiene must immediately follow doffing.
byChoice.zh: 这是违规，因为脱手套时病原体可能转移到手上；脱除后必须立即手卫生。

byChoice.en: This is a breach because the door handle becomes a fomite that others may touch after care of a CDI client.
byChoice.zh: 这是违规，因为在照护 CDI 患者后，门把手会成为其他人可能接触的污染媒介。

testTakingStrategy.en: Separate true breaches from correct dedicated-equipment use. For contact precautions, ask: Was full PPE used, was hand hygiene done after doffing, and were shared surfaces protected?
testTakingStrategy.zh: 把真正的违规与正确使用专用设备区分开。遇到接触隔离题，追问：是否使用了完整 PPE、脱除后是否手卫生、是否保护了共用表面。

stem.en: Stage 2: Client D has smear-positive pulmonary TB in a functioning AIIR. Her mother asks to take her outside in a wheelchair for fresh air. Which response is best?
stem.zh: 阶段2：D 患者为痰涂片阳性肺结核，住在功能正常的 AIIR。母亲请求用轮椅带她到室外呼吸新鲜空气。哪项回应最合适？

options.en: Tell the mother she does not need respiratory protection inside the AIIR because negative pressure protects everyone in the room.
options.zh: 告诉母亲在 AIIR 内不需要呼吸防护，因为负压会保护房内所有人。

options.en: Explain that a non-essential trip outside the AIIR is not permitted while AFB smears remain positive; offer in-room comfort alternatives and teach the mother to follow the facility airborne-precautions visitor policy, including instruction and offering of an N95 respirator.
options.zh: 解释 AFB 涂片仍阳性期间不得因非必要原因离开 AIIR；提供病房内舒适替代措施，并指导母亲遵循机构空气传播隔离探视政策，包括说明并提供 N95 呼吸防护口罩。

options.en: Delay answering until the provider makes rounds because nurses do not teach airborne-precautions restrictions.
options.zh: 等医务人员查房后再回答，因为护士不负责空气传播隔离限制的教育。

options.en: Allow a brief outdoor trip if the patient wears a surgical mask the entire time.
options.zh: 如果患者全程戴外科口罩，就允许短暂到室外。

options.en: Give the mother a surgical mask and explain that this reliably protects visitors from airborne TB while inside the room.
options.zh: 给母亲外科口罩，并解释这能在房内可靠保护探视者免受空气传播结核感染。

correct.en: The patient is still AFB smear-positive, and the case states the AIIR is functioning and precautions must continue. A non-essential outdoor trip would bypass the engineering control. A surgical mask on the patient is used only when medically necessary transport cannot be avoided; it is not a substitute for the AIIR. The nurse should respond compassionately, offer alternatives, and teach visitor respiratory-protection expectations under facility policy.
correct.zh: 患者 AFB 涂片仍阳性，且病例说明 AIIR 功能正常、隔离需继续。非必要外出会绕过负压工程控制。患者外科口罩仅用于不可避免的医学必要转运，不能替代 AIIR。护士应以同理方式回应，提供替代措施，并按机构政策教育探视者呼吸防护要求。

byChoice.en: A patient surgical mask is for medically necessary transport; it does not make a non-essential trip acceptable while the client remains smear-positive.
byChoice.zh: 患者外科口罩用于医学必要转运；涂片阳性期间不能因此允许非必要外出。

byChoice.en: Negative pressure helps keep room air from escaping to adjacent areas; it does not protect a visitor who is inside the room from inhaling droplet nuclei.
byChoice.zh: 负压有助于防止室内空气逸散到邻近区域；但不能保护房内探视者不吸入飞沫核。

byChoice.en: A surgical mask is not reliable respiratory protection for a visitor against airborne TB in the room; the case's visitor policy includes N95 instruction and offering.
byChoice.zh: 外科口罩不是探视者在房内防护空气传播结核的可靠呼吸防护；病例中的探视政策包括 N95 指导和提供。

byChoice.en: Nurses are responsible for reinforcing isolation precautions and visitor teaching; delaying leaves an active safety question unresolved.
byChoice.zh: 护士有责任强化隔离预防和探视者教育；拖延会让正在发生的安全问题得不到处理。

byChoice.en: This protects others from airborne TB, uses the case's current smear-positive status, and addresses the mother's concern without dismissing her.
byChoice.zh: 这能保护他人免受空气传播结核，依据病例中涂片阳性的当前状态，并在不忽视母亲担忧的情况下回应。

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not let a compassionate request override the isolation category. For airborne TB, ask whether the trip is medically necessary and whether the AIIR can be replaced by a mask; here, it cannot.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要让合情合理的请求凌驾于隔离类别之上。遇到空气传播结核，先问外出是否医学必要，以及口罩能否替代 AIIR；本题不能。

stem.en: Stage 3: The charge nurse asks which identified breach posed the greatest cross-contamination risk to other clients on the unit. Which breach should the nurse identify as the priority?
stem.zh: 阶段3：责任护士询问已发现的哪个漏洞对病区其他患者造成最大的交叉污染风险。护士应优先指出哪一项？

options.en: The nursing student's contaminated bare-hand contact with the Room 12 door handle
options.zh: 护生用污染裸手触碰12房门把手

options.en: The standard linen bag used for Client A's soiled linens
options.zh: A 患者污染布草被放入普通布草袋

options.en: Client B's wife stopping at the open doorway of Room 12 to ask a question
options.zh: B 患者妻子停在12房开着的门口询问问题

options.en: Client C's dedicated stethoscope placed on the clean-utility-room counter near the clean supply cart
options.zh: C 患者专用听诊器被放在清洁用物间柜台上，靠近清洁物品车

correct.en: The stethoscope breach has the widest and most direct cross-contamination pathway: a device from a draining MRSA contact-precautions room was placed in a clean supply area used for multiple clients. It could contaminate surfaces, supplies, and staff hands. The door handle and linen bagging errors are serious, but their exposure radius is more contained.
correct.zh: 听诊器漏洞具有最广且最直接的交叉污染路径：来自 MRSA 引流伤口接触隔离病房的设备被放到供多名患者使用的清洁物品区域，可能污染表面、物品和工作人员双手。门把手和布草装袋错误也严重，但暴露范围较有限。

byChoice.en: The wife needs reassurance and hand-hygiene teaching, but merely stopping at the doorway is not the highest-risk breach described.
byChoice.zh: 妻子需要安抚和手卫生教育，但仅停在门口不是本题描述的最高风险漏洞。

byChoice.en: The contaminated door handle is serious but is one high-touch surface at one doorway and can be addressed with targeted disinfection.
byChoice.zh: 污染门把手很严重，但它是单一门口的一个高频接触表面，可通过定点消毒处理。

byChoice.en: The linen-bagging error matters, especially for CDI, but it primarily creates downstream laundry-handling risk rather than immediate lateral spread to multiple clients.
byChoice.zh: 布草装袋错误很重要，尤其涉及 CDI，但主要增加下游洗涤处理风险，而非立即向多名患者横向传播。

byChoice.en: This is the priority because a contaminated dedicated device entered a clean supply area, creating an expanding fomite pathway to many clients.
byChoice.zh: 这是优先事项，因为污染的专用设备进入清洁物品区域，形成可扩大的污染媒介路径，影响多名患者。

testTakingStrategy.en: Prioritization in infection control is about scope and pathway: choose the breach that can spread organisms to the most clients through the most direct route.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 感染控制优先级要看范围和传播路径：选择能通过最直接路径把病原体传播给最多患者的漏洞。

stem.en: Stage 1: Which nursing actions are appropriate when teaching Client C's daughter about MRSA contact precautions? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 阶段1：护士教育 C 患者女儿有关 MRSA 接触隔离时，哪些措施合适？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Show her where PPE is located and ask for a return demonstration of donning, doffing, and hand hygiene.
options.zh: 告诉她 PPE 放置位置，并请她回示穿戴、脱除和手卫生。

options.en: Tell her not to touch or reposition her father until the wound has healed.
options.zh: 告诉她在伤口愈合前不要触碰或协助父亲翻身。

options.en: Explain that the draining MRSA wound can spread organisms by direct contact with hands, clothing, or linens.
options.zh: 解释有引流的 MRSA 伤口可通过手、衣物或床单等直接接触传播病原体。

options.en: Acknowledge that she was not previously oriented and thank her for helping with care.
options.zh: 承认她先前未被指导，并感谢她协助照护。

options.en: Give her a surgical mask as the main protection for MRSA contact precautions.
options.zh: 给她外科口罩作为 MRSA 接触隔离的主要防护。

options.en: Teach that gown and gloves are required for room entry and direct contact with the client or bed linens.
options.zh: 告知进入病房以及直接接触患者或床单时需要穿隔离衣并戴手套。

correct.en: The daughter can remain involved in care, but she needs nonjudgmental teaching, clear explanation of contact spread, gown and glove use, and return demonstration. MRSA is spread mainly by contact in this scenario, so gown, gloves, and hand hygiene are the priority, not a surgical mask.
correct.zh: 女儿可以继续参与照护，但需要非评判式指导、清楚解释接触传播、使用隔离衣和手套，并进行回示。本情境中 MRSA 主要通过接触传播，因此重点是隔离衣、手套和手卫生，而不是外科口罩。

byChoice.en: This gives the reason for precautions and links the open draining wound to contact transmission.
byChoice.zh: 这说明采取隔离措施的原因，并将开放引流伤口与接触传播联系起来。

byChoice.en: This matches contact-precautions PPE for direct contact with the client and contaminated linens.
byChoice.zh: 这符合直接接触患者和污染床单时的接触隔离 PPE 要求。

byChoice.en: A surgical mask is not the main intervention for MRSA contact precautions; gown, gloves, and hand hygiene are.
byChoice.zh: 外科口罩不是 MRSA 接触隔离的主要措施；主要措施是隔离衣、手套和手卫生。

byChoice.en: This is unnecessarily restrictive; the safer plan is to teach her how to help while wearing PPE.
byChoice.zh: 这过度限制；更安全的做法是教她在穿戴 PPE 的情况下继续协助。

byChoice.en: Return demonstration verifies that teaching changed the visitor's behavior, not just her verbal understanding.
byChoice.zh: 回示可确认教学转化为行为改变，而不仅是口头理解。

byChoice.en: This supports adherence by correcting a system gap without blaming the visitor.
byChoice.zh: 这样可在不责备探视者的情况下纠正系统性遗漏，促进依从性。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a visitor makes an isolation error, choose teaching that preserves safe family involvement and verifies the behavior with return demonstration.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 探视者出现隔离错误时，选择既能保留安全家庭参与、又能通过回示确认行为的教学措施。

evidenceCatalog.text: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。
集中照护期间预防交叉污染

A day-shift nurse on a medical-surgical unit is caring for four adjacent clients: Client A with Clostridioides difficile infection on contact precautions, Client B with community-acquired pneumonia on standard precautions, Client C with a draining MRSA pressure injury on contact precautions, and Client D with smear-positive pulmonary TB in a functioning airborne infection isolation room. The nurse must model safe practice for a nursing student, teach visitors, and contain several infection-control breaches during the shift.
一名日班护士在内外科病区照护四名相邻病房的患者：A 患者为艰难梭菌感染并执行接触隔离，B 患者为社区获得性肺炎并执行标准预防，C 患者有引流性 MRSA 3期压力性损伤并执行接触隔离，D 患者为痰涂片阳性肺结核并住在功能正常的空气传播感染隔离病房。护士需要为护生示范正确做法，教育探视者，并在班次中控制多项感染控制漏洞。

Standing rules at each doorway and reviewed at shift huddle:
1. Alcohol-based hand rub (ABHR) is the default hand-hygiene method except when hands are visibly soiled or the client has a known or suspected spore-forming organism; then soap and water is required.
2. Dedicated or single-use equipment is required for clients on contact precautions. If a device must be shared, clean visible soil, disinfect with an appropriate agent, and allow the manufacturer-specified wet-contact time before the device enters the next room.
3. PPE is donned outside the room and doffed inside the room, gloves first and then gown, before exiting; perform hand hygiene immediately after removal.
4. Visitors are offered a precautions orientation at the first visit of each shift, including hand hygiene and required PPE.
5. Soiled linen from any isolation room is placed in a water-soluble inner bag and then into a labeled outer bag at the point of use.

各病房门口张贴并在交班小会上复习的常规制度：
1. 酒精类手消毒剂（ABHR）为默认手卫生方式；但手部明显污染或患者有已知/疑似产孢子病原体时，必须使用肥皂和清水洗手。
2. 接触隔离患者需使用专用或一次性设备。如设备必须共用，应先清除可见污物，再用合适消毒剂消毒，并达到厂家规定的湿接触时间后，才能进入下一间病房。
3. PPE 在病房外穿戴；离开前在病房内脱除，先脱手套再脱隔离衣；脱除后立即进行手卫生。
4. 探视者在每个班次首次探视时接受隔离预防指导，包括手卫生和所需 PPE。
5. 任何隔离病房的污染布草应在使用地点先放入水溶性内袋，再放入有标识的外袋。

Client A, Room 12: 71-year-old post-op day 2 after right hemicolectomy. Six watery stools overnight; stool PCR positive for Clostridioides difficile at 0545. Contact precautions. Dedicated thermometer and blood-pressure cuff are in the room. Last void 7 hours ago; bladder scan ordered.
Client B, Room 14: 58-year-old with community-acquired pneumonia on standard precautions only. Oxygen by nasal cannula at 3 L/min; SpO2 93-94%. Suprapubic fullness; bladder scan ordered after Client A.
Client C, Room 16: 44-year-old with a large stage 3 sacral pressure injury, culture-positive for MRSA, open and draining through the dressing. Contact precautions. Dedicated stethoscope and blood-pressure cuff are in the room. Daughter has been helping reposition him.
Client D, Room 18: 29-year-old with confirmed pulmonary TB, sputum AFB smear positive, in a negative-pressure AIIR with green indicator light. Airborne plus standard precautions. Mother is at bedside.

A 患者，12房：71岁，右半结肠切除术后第2天。夜间水样便6次；0545 粪便 PCR 艰难梭菌阳性。执行接触隔离。房内有专用体温计和血压袖带。7小时未排尿，已医嘱膀胱扫描。
B 患者，14房：58岁，社区获得性肺炎，仅执行标准预防。鼻导管吸氧 3 L/min，SpO2 93–94%。诉耻骨上胀满；计划在 A 患者之后进行膀胱扫描。
C 患者，16房：44岁，骶尾部大型 3期压力性损伤，培养 MRSA 阳性，伤口开放且敷料有引流渗出。执行接触隔离。房内有专用听诊器和血压袖带。女儿一直协助翻身。
D 患者，18房：29岁，确诊肺结核，痰 AFB 涂片阳性，住在负压 AIIR，指示灯为绿色。执行空气传播隔离加标准预防。母亲在床旁。

While the nurse is assessing Client A while wearing gown and gloves after soap-and-water hand hygiene, a nursing student steps into Room 12 wearing gloves but no gown. The student uses Client A's dedicated blood-pressure cuff, removes her gloves inside the room, and then touches the door handle with bare, unwashed hands. The nurse stops the student before she exits, directs soap-and-water hand hygiene, and arranges door-handle disinfection.
护士在完成肥皂和清水洗手并穿戴隔离衣和手套后，正在评估 A 患者。此时护生进入12房，只戴手套、未穿隔离衣。护生使用 A 患者的专用血压袖带，在房内脱下手套，然后用未清洁的裸手触碰门把手。护士在护生离开前立即制止，指导其用肥皂和清水洗手，并安排对门把手消毒。

At 0745, the nurse uses the portable bladder scanner on Client A; post-void residual is 410 mL, and the provider is notified. The scanner is also needed for Client B, who is on standard precautions. At 0800, Client C's daughter is in Room 16 in street clothes with no gown or gloves. She has been repositioning her father and says, "I've been coming every day — nobody told me I needed to put anything on." Client C's dressing is saturated and due for change.
0745，护士为 A 患者使用便携式膀胱扫描仪；残余尿量为 410 mL，已通知医务人员。该扫描仪随后还需用于仅执行标准预防的 B 患者。0800，C 患者女儿在16房，穿普通衣服，未穿隔离衣、未戴手套。她一直协助父亲翻身，并说：“我每天都来——没人告诉我需要穿戴什么。” C 患者敷料已被渗液浸透，需更换。
Stage 1 — 0700 to 0900: shift organization and first rounds
阶段1 — 0700至0900：安排班次并首次查房

0915: Client D's mother asks at the nurses' station whether she can take her daughter outside in a wheelchair for ten minutes of fresh air. The mother is not wearing a mask.
0945: During Client C's wound dressing change, the nurse notices Client C's dedicated stethoscope sitting on the clean-utility-room counter next to the clean supply cart. A housekeeper reports another staff member carried it out of Room 16 about 20 minutes earlier.
1030: Client A has another large watery stool. While the nurse is gowned and gloved in Room 12, soiled linens are bundled into a standard linen bag instead of a water-soluble inner bag and labeled outer bag. The student asks whether this matters.
1100: Client B's wife arrives, stops at Room 12's open doorway, sees the contact-precautions sign, and asks if she should worry because her husband is next door.

0915：D 患者母亲在护士站询问，能否用轮椅带女儿到室外呼吸10分钟新鲜空气。母亲未戴口罩。
0945：护士为 C 患者更换伤口敷料时，发现 C 患者的专用听诊器放在清洁用物间柜台上，靠近清洁物品车。保洁人员说约20分钟前有另一名工作人员把它从16房拿出并放在那里。
1030：A 患者再次大量水样便。护士在12房内穿戴隔离衣和手套协助清洁时，污染布草被装入普通布草袋，而不是先放入水溶性内袋再放入有标识外袋。护生询问这是否重要。
1100：B 患者妻子到达，停在12房开着的门口，看到接触隔离标识，询问丈夫就在隔壁是否需要担心。

Client A: T 38.4 C, HR 110, BP 100/58; two additional large watery stools since 0900, intake 750 mL IV, output about 1,100 mL; potassium 3.1 mEq/L, creatinine 1.5 mg/dL.
Client B: stable; post-void residual 45 mL; preliminary sputum culture Streptococcus pneumoniae susceptible to ceftriaxone.
Client C: dressing changed; wound appearance unchanged; vancomycin monitoring managed by pharmacy.
Client D: remains in AIIR; morning sputum AFB smear still positive (2+); mother remains at bedside and the outdoor-trip request has not yet been addressed.

A 患者：T 101.1 °F (38.4 °C)，HR 110，BP 100/58；0900后又有2次大量水样便，IV 入量 750 mL，尿液和粪便总出量约 1,100 mL；血钾 3.1 mEq/L，肌酐 1.5 mg/dL。
B 患者：情况稳定；残余尿量 45 mL；痰培养初步为肺炎链球菌，对头孢曲松敏感。
C 患者：敷料已更换；伤口外观无变化；万古霉素监测由药房按制度管理。
D 患者：仍在 AIIR；晨痰 AFB 涂片仍阳性（2+）；母亲仍在床旁，外出请求尚未处理。

1215: The nurse debriefs the student about the Room 12 entry without a gown, missed hand hygiene after glove removal, door-handle contact, the linen-bagging error, and the stethoscope found in the clean utility room.
1230: The charge nurse asks which identified breach posed the greatest cross-contamination risk to other clients and why.
1300: Client D's repeat sputum AFB smear remains positive (2+); the provider confirms airborne precautions and AIIR must continue. The nurse teaches the patient and mother that non-essential trips outside the AIIR are not permitted while smear-positive; a surgical mask is used on the patient only for medically necessary transport, and visitors follow the facility airborne-precautions policy with instruction and offering of an N95 respirator.
End of shift: Client C's daughter correctly demonstrates gown and glove donning and doffing. The contaminated stethoscope is retrieved; clean-utility surfaces it may have touched are disinfected; potentially contaminated nearby supplies are removed or handled per policy; the stethoscope is disinfected with full wet-contact time and returned to Room 16. Client A's CDI diarrhea continues; contact precautions remain. Client D remains smear-positive in AIIR. The student requires follow-up education and supervised return demonstration.

1215：护士与护生重点复盘12房未穿隔离衣进入、脱手套后未手卫生、触碰门把手、布草装袋错误，以及在清洁用物间发现听诊器的问题。
1230：责任护士询问已发现的哪些漏洞对其他患者造成最大的交叉污染风险，以及原因。
1300：D 患者复查痰 AFB 涂片仍阳性（2+）；医务人员确认必须继续空气传播隔离和 AIIR。护士向患者和母亲解释：涂片阳性期间不得因非必要原因离开 AIIR；只有医学必要转运时才给患者戴外科口罩；探视者需遵循机构空气传播隔离探视政策，包括指导并提供 N95 呼吸防护口罩。
班末：C 患者女儿能正确回示隔离衣和手套的穿脱。污染听诊器已取回；其可能接触的清洁用物间表面已消毒；附近可能污染的物品已按制度移除或处理；听诊器完成全程湿接触时间消毒后送回16房。A 患者 CDI 腹泻仍持续，继续接触隔离。D 患者仍为涂片阳性并留在 AIIR。护生需要后续教育和受监督回示。
Stage 3 — 1200 to 1500: resolution, teaching, and evaluation
阶段3 — 1200至1500：处理、教学与评价
Stage 1: Put the steps in the correct order for handling the portable bladder scanner after use on Client A before taking it to Client B.
阶段1：将为 A 患者使用便携式膀胱扫描仪后、带去 B 患者房间前的处理步骤按正确顺序排列。
Stage 3: Which statements show an accurate evaluation of whether the infection-control interventions were effective? Select all that apply.
阶段3：哪些陈述能准确评价感染控制干预是否有效？选择所有适用项。
Stage 1: Classify each nursing-student behavior in Client A's Clostridioides difficile room.
阶段1：请判断护生在 A 患者艰难梭菌病房中的每项行为。
Entering the contact-precautions room wearing gloves but no gown
进入接触隔离病房时只戴手套、未穿隔离衣
Using the blood-pressure cuff dedicated to Room 12
使用12房专用的血压袖带
Removing gloves and failing to perform hand hygiene immediately afterward
脱下手套后未立即进行手卫生
Touching the door handle with bare, unwashed hands after client contact
接触患者后用未清洁的裸手触碰门把手
This is a breach because clothing can be contaminated during contact-precautions care; gloves alone are not enough.
这是违规，因为接触隔离照护中衣物可能被污染；仅戴手套不够。
This is not a breach because the cuff is dedicated to Client A's room and is not being moved to another client.
这不是违规，因为该袖带专用于 A 患者房间，并未拿给其他患者使用。
This is a breach because organisms can be transferred during glove removal; hand hygiene must immediately follow doffing.
这是违规，因为脱手套时病原体可能转移到手上；脱除后必须立即手卫生。
This is a breach because the door handle becomes a fomite that others may touch after care of a CDI client.
这是违规，因为在照护 CDI 患者后，门把手会成为其他人可能接触的污染媒介。

Contact precautions require gown and gloves before room entry. The dedicated cuff belongs in Room 12 and is appropriate to use. The major failures are missing the gown, missing immediate hand hygiene after glove removal, and touching a shared surface with contaminated bare hands; in a C. difficile room, the required hand-hygiene method is soap and water.
接触隔离要求进入病房前穿隔离衣并戴手套。12房专用血压袖带可在该房内使用。主要问题是未穿隔离衣、脱手套后未立即手卫生，以及用污染的裸手触碰共用表面；在艰难梭菌病房，所需手卫生方式为肥皂和清水洗手。
Separate true breaches from correct dedicated-equipment use. For contact precautions, ask: Was full PPE used, was hand hygiene done after doffing, and were shared surfaces protected?
把真正的违规与正确使用专用设备区分开。遇到接触隔离题，追问：是否使用了完整 PPE、脱除后是否手卫生、是否保护了共用表面。
Stage 1: Which nursing actions are appropriate when teaching Client C's daughter about MRSA contact precautions? Select all that apply.
阶段1：护士教育 C 患者女儿有关 MRSA 接触隔离时，哪些措施合适？选择所有适用项。

告诉她 PPE 放置位置，并请她回示穿戴、脱除和手卫生。
Tell her not to touch or reposition her father until the wound has healed.
告诉她在伤口愈合前不要触碰或协助父亲翻身。

承认她先前未被指导，并感谢她协助照护。

给她外科口罩作为 MRSA 接触隔离的主要防护。

告知进入病房以及直接接触患者或床单时需要穿隔离衣并戴手套。
This gives the reason for precautions and links the open draining wound to contact transmission.
这说明采取隔离措施的原因，并将开放引流伤口与接触传播联系起来。
This matches contact-precautions PPE for direct contact with the client and contaminated linens.
这符合直接接触患者和污染床单时的接触隔离 PPE 要求。
A surgical mask is not the main intervention for MRSA contact precautions; gown, gloves, and hand hygiene are.
外科口罩不是 MRSA 接触隔离的主要措施；主要措施是隔离衣、手套和手卫生。
This is unnecessarily restrictive; the safer plan is to teach her how to help while wearing PPE.
这过度限制；更安全的做法是教她在穿戴 PPE 的情况下继续协助。

回示可确认教学转化为行为改变，而不仅是口头理解。

这样可在不责备探视者的情况下纠正系统性遗漏，促进依从性。

女儿可以继续参与照护，但需要非评判式指导、清楚解释接触传播、使用隔离衣和手套，并进行回示。本情境中 MRSA 主要通过接触传播，因此重点是隔离衣、手套和手卫生，而不是外科口罩。

Stage 3: The charge nurse asks which identified breach posed the greatest cross-contamination risk to other clients on the unit. Which breach should the nurse identify as the priority?
阶段3：责任护士询问已发现的哪个漏洞对病区其他患者造成最大的交叉污染风险。护士应优先指出哪一项？
The nursing student's contaminated bare-hand contact with the Room 12 door handle
护生用污染裸手触碰12房门把手
The standard linen bag used for Client A's soiled linens
A 患者污染布草被放入普通布草袋
Client B's wife stopping at the open doorway of Room 12 to ask a question
B 患者妻子停在12房开着的门口询问问题
Client C's dedicated stethoscope placed on the clean-utility-room counter near the clean supply cart
C 患者专用听诊器被放在清洁用物间柜台上，靠近清洁物品车
The wife needs reassurance and hand-hygiene teaching, but merely stopping at the doorway is not the highest-risk breach described.
妻子需要安抚和手卫生教育，但仅停在门口不是本题描述的最高风险漏洞。
The contaminated door handle is serious but is one high-touch surface at one doorway and can be addressed with targeted disinfection.
污染门把手很严重，但它是单一门口的一个高频接触表面，可通过定点消毒处理。
The linen-bagging error matters, especially for CDI, but it primarily creates downstream laundry-handling risk rather than immediate lateral spread to multiple clients.
布草装袋错误很重要，尤其涉及 CDI，但主要增加下游洗涤处理风险，而非立即向多名患者横向传播。
This is the priority because a contaminated dedicated device entered a clean supply area, creating an expanding fomite pathway to many clients.
这是优先事项，因为污染的专用设备进入清洁物品区域，形成可扩大的污染媒介路径，影响多名患者。

The stethoscope breach has the widest and most direct cross-contamination pathway: a device from a draining MRSA contact-precautions room was placed in a clean supply area used for multiple clients. It could contaminate surfaces, supplies, and staff hands. The door handle and linen bagging errors are serious, but their exposure radius is more contained.
听诊器漏洞具有最广且最直接的交叉污染路径：来自 MRSA 引流伤口接触隔离病房的设备被放到供多名患者使用的清洁物品区域，可能污染表面、物品和工作人员双手。门把手和布草装袋错误也严重，但暴露范围较有限。
Prioritization in infection control is about scope and pathway: choose the breach that can spread organisms to the most clients through the most direct route.
感染控制优先级要看范围和传播路径：选择能通过最直接路径把病原体传播给最多患者的漏洞。
Stage 2: Client D has smear-positive pulmonary TB in a functioning AIIR. Her mother asks to take her outside in a wheelchair for fresh air. Which response is best?
阶段2：D 患者为痰涂片阳性肺结核，住在功能正常的 AIIR。母亲请求用轮椅带她到室外呼吸新鲜空气。哪项回应最合适？
Tell the mother she does not need respiratory protection inside the AIIR because negative pressure protects everyone in the room.
告诉母亲在 AIIR 内不需要呼吸防护，因为负压会保护房内所有人。

Explain that a non-essential trip outside the AIIR is not permitted while AFB smears remain positive; offer in-room comfort alternatives and teach the mother to follow the facility airborne-precautions visitor policy, including instruction and offering of an N95 respirator.
解释 AFB 涂片仍阳性期间不得因非必要原因离开 AIIR；提供病房内舒适替代措施，并指导母亲遵循机构空气传播隔离探视政策，包括说明并提供 N95 呼吸防护口罩。
Delay answering until the provider makes rounds because nurses do not teach airborne-precautions restrictions.
等医务人员查房后再回答，因为护士不负责空气传播隔离限制的教育。
Allow a brief outdoor trip if the patient wears a surgical mask the entire time.
如果患者全程戴外科口罩，就允许短暂到室外。
Give the mother a surgical mask and explain that this reliably protects visitors from airborne TB while inside the room.
给母亲外科口罩，并解释这能在房内可靠保护探视者免受空气传播结核感染。
A patient surgical mask is for medically necessary transport; it does not make a non-essential trip acceptable while the client remains smear-positive.
患者外科口罩用于医学必要转运；涂片阳性期间不能因此允许非必要外出。
Negative pressure helps keep room air from escaping to adjacent areas; it does not protect a visitor who is inside the room from inhaling droplet nuclei.
负压有助于防止室内空气逸散到邻近区域；但不能保护房内探视者不吸入飞沫核。
A surgical mask is not reliable respiratory protection for a visitor against airborne TB in the room; the case's visitor policy includes N95 instruction and offering.
外科口罩不是探视者在房内防护空气传播结核的可靠呼吸防护；病例中的探视政策包括 N95 指导和提供。
Nurses are responsible for reinforcing isolation precautions and visitor teaching; delaying leaves an active safety question unresolved.
护士有责任强化隔离预防和探视者教育；拖延会让正在发生的安全问题得不到处理。
This protects others from airborne TB, uses the case's current smear-positive status, and addresses the mother's concern without dismissing her.
这能保护他人免受空气传播结核，依据病例中涂片阳性的当前状态，并在不忽视母亲担忧的情况下回应。

The patient is still AFB smear-positive, and the case states the AIIR is functioning and precautions must continue. A non-essential outdoor trip would bypass the engineering control. A surgical mask on the patient is used only when medically necessary transport cannot be avoided; it is not a substitute for the AIIR. The nurse should respond compassionately, offer alternatives, and teach visitor respiratory-protection expectations under facility policy.
患者 AFB 涂片仍阳性，且病例说明 AIIR 功能正常、隔离需继续。非必要外出会绕过负压工程控制。患者外科口罩仅用于不可避免的医学必要转运，不能替代 AIIR。护士应以同理方式回应，提供替代措施，并按机构政策教育探视者呼吸防护要求。
Do not let a compassionate request override the isolation category. For airborne TB, ask whether the trip is medically necessary and whether the AIIR can be replaced by a mask; here, it cannot.
不要让合情合理的请求凌驾于隔离类别之上。遇到空气传播结核，先问外出是否医学必要，以及口罩能否替代 AIIR；本题不能。

title.en: Clostridioides difficile infection with dehydration and contact-precaution teaching for family visitors.
title.zh: 艰难梭菌感染伴脱水以及家属探视的接触隔离宣教。

summary.en: A 71-year-old woman is transferred from a skilled nursing facility to a medical-surgical unit with a three-day history of profuse, watery, foul-smelling diarrhea. She completed a 10-day course of oral amoxicillin-clavulanate for community-acquired pneumonia six days ago. Her medical history includes type 2 diabetes managed with metformin 1,000 mg twice daily, hypertension treated with lisinopril 20 mg daily, osteoarthritis, and mild chronic kidney disease (baseline creatinine 1.4 mg/dL, baseline eGFR 42 mL/min/1.73 m²). She lives with her adult daughter and son-in-law, who visit daily and assist with meals and hygiene. On admission, the provider orders contact precautions, stool specimen for C. difficile toxin PCR, IV lactated Ringer's 500 mL bolus over 1 hour, then maintain at 125 mL/hr, strict intake and output, daily basic metabolic panel, and oral vancomycin 125 mg every 6 hours per facility protocol for suspected C. difficile infection. Metformin is held pending evaluation of renal function. A Braden scale assessment is ordered every shift.
summary.zh: 一名71岁女性患者因连续3天出现大量水样、恶臭腹泻，从专业护理机构转入内外科病房。她于6天前完成了为期10天的口服阿莫西林-克拉维酸治疗社区获得性肺炎的疗程。既往病史包括2型糖尿病（规律服用二甲双胍1000 mg，每日两次）、高血压（规律服用赖诺普利20 mg，每日一次）、骨关节炎以及轻度慢性肾脏病（基线肌酐1.4 mg/dL，基线eGFR 42 mL/min/1.73 m²）。她与成年的女儿和女婿同住，他们每天来探视并协助进食和个人卫生。入院时，考虑到疑似艰难梭菌感染，医生下达医嘱：接触隔离，留取粪便标本行艰难梭菌毒素PCR检测，静脉输注乳酸林格氏液 500 mL 负荷量（1小时内滴完），随后以 125 mL/hr 维持，严格记录出入量，每日复查基础代谢指标（BMP），并根据机构方案给予口服万古霉素125 mg，每6小时一次。二甲双胍暂停使用，待评估肾功能后决定。每班进行一次Braden量表评估。

content.en:
The patient reports six to eight loose, watery stools per day for the past three days, accompanied by diffuse crampy abdominal pain, poor oral intake, and increasing fatigue. She states she feels lightheaded when she stands and has not been eating well because "everything makes my stomach worse."

**Assessment Findings:** Temperature 100.6 °F (38.1 °C), heart rate 104, blood pressure 98/62, respiratory rate 18, SpO₂ 96% on room air. Weight 64 kg (documented weight two weeks ago was 68 kg). Mucous membranes dry and tacky, skin turgor sluggish over the sternum, capillary refill 3 seconds. Abdomen soft, diffusely tender without rebound or guarding; hyperactive bowel sounds. Perianal skin intact but erythematous. Braden score 15 (mild risk).

**Laboratory Data:** WBC 18.2 ×10³/µL, hemoglobin 13.8 g/dL, platelets 210 ×10³/µL. Sodium 139 mEq/L, potassium 3.3 mEq/L, chloride 96 mEq/L, bicarbonate 20 mEq/L, BUN 38 mg/dL, creatinine 2.1 mg/dL, eGFR 24 mL/min/1.73 m², glucose 188 mg/dL. Lactate 2.4 mmol/L. Albumin 2.8 g/dL. Stool C. difficile toxin PCR pending.
content.zh:
患者报告过去三天每天有6至8次稀水样便，伴有弥漫性痉挛性腹痛，进食差，疲劳感加重。她表示站立时感到头晕，并且因为“吃什么都让胃更难受”而没有好好进食。

**评估结果：** 体温 100.6 °F (38.1 °C)，心率 104，血压 98/62，呼吸频率 18，室内空气下SpO₂ 96%。体重 64 kg（两周前记录的体重为 68 kg）。黏膜干燥发粘，胸骨上方皮肤弹性迟缓，毛细血管充盈时间3秒。腹软，全腹弥漫性压痛，无反跳痛或肌紧张；肠鸣音活跃。肛周皮肤完整但有红斑。Braden量表评分 15分（轻度危险）。

**实验室数据：** WBC 18.2 ×10³/µL，血红蛋白 13.8 g/dL，血小板 210 ×10³/µL。钠 139 mEq/L，钾 3.3 mEq/L，氯 96 mEq/L，碳酸氢盐 20 mEq/L，BUN 38 mg/dL，肌酐 2.1 mg/dL，eGFR 24 mL/min/1.73 m²，葡萄糖 188 mg/dL。乳酸 2.4 mmol/L。白蛋白 2.8 g/dL。粪便艰难梭菌毒素PCR结果待报。

content.en:
The C. difficile toxin PCR returns positive. The patient has had four more watery stools since admission. Intake: 1,400 mL IV fluids; output: 200 mL urine plus an estimated 1,200 mL stool. She remains tachycardic (HR 100) and hypotensive (BP 100/64). Repeat potassium drawn at 6 hours is 3.1 mEq/L. The provider is notified and orders IV potassium chloride 10 mEq in 100 mL normal saline over 1 hour via peripheral IV, repeat once; recheck potassium after replacement.

The patient's daughter and son-in-law arrive for their evening visit. The nurse observes the daughter enter the room wearing gloves but no gown, and the son-in-law follows her in without any personal protective equipment. The son-in-law picks up the bedside TV remote and then touches the patient's hand.
content.zh:
艰难梭菌毒素PCR结果呈阳性。自入院以来，患者又排了四次水样便。入量：1400 mL静脉输液；出量：200 mL尿液加上估计 1200 mL的粪便。她仍然表现为心动过速（心率 100）和低血压（血压 100/64）。入院后6小时复查的血钾为 3.1 mEq/L。已通知医生，医嘱要求通过外周静脉在1小时内静脉输注10 mEq氯化钾加入100 mL生理盐水中，重复一次；补钾后复查血钾。

患者的女儿和女婿晚上来探视。护士观察到女儿戴着手套但未穿隔离衣进入病房，女婿紧随其后进入，未穿戴任何个人防护装备（PPE）。女婿拿起病床旁的电视遥控器，然后摸了摸患者的手。

content.en:
The patient's stool frequency has decreased to three episodes over the past 8 hours. Repeat labs: potassium 3.6 mEq/L (post-replacement), creatinine 1.9 mg/dL, BUN 34 mg/dL, lactate 1.8 mmol/L. Vitals: T 99.7 °F (37.6 °C), HR 92, BP 108/68, RR 16, SpO₂ 97%. Urine output over the past 8 hours is 280 mL. She is tolerating small sips of clear liquids.

The perianal erythema has worsened: the skin is now macerated with a shallow 1 cm × 0.5 cm area of partial-thickness skin loss at the 6-o'clock position. The Braden moisture subscale has dropped to 1 (constantly moist).

The daughter asks the nurse, "Can I just use hand sanitizer instead of washing my hands every time? It's faster." She also asks whether she needs to wear a gown and gloves when she is "just sitting in the chair and not touching Mom."
content.zh:
在过去的8小时内，患者的排便频率已降至三次。复查实验室指标：钾 3.6 mEq/L（补钾后），肌酐 1.9 mg/dL，BUN 34 mg/dL，乳酸 1.8 mmol/L。生命体征：体温 99.7 °F (37.6 °C)，心率 92，血压 108/68，呼吸 16，SpO₂ 97%。过去8小时的尿量为 280 mL。她能够耐受小口啜饮清流质饮食。

肛周红斑恶化：皮肤现在出现浸渍，在6点钟位置有一个 1 cm × 0.5 cm 的浅表部分皮层缺失区域。Braden量表的潮湿子项评分已降至1分（持续潮湿）。

女儿问护士：“我可以只用免洗手消液而不是每次都洗手吗？那样比较快。”她还问，如果她“只是坐在椅子上，不接触妈妈”，是否还需要穿隔离衣和戴手套。

content.en:
Stool frequency is down to two formed-to-semiformed stools in the past 12 hours. Repeat labs: potassium 3.8 mEq/L, creatinine 1.6 mg/dL, BUN 28 mg/dL, eGFR 33 mL/min/1.73 m², lactate 1.2 mmol/L, WBC 12.4 ×10³/µL. Vitals: T 99 °F (37.2 °C), HR 82, BP 118/72, RR 16, SpO₂ 98%. Urine output over the past 8 hours is 400 mL (50 mL/hr). The patient is eating a soft diet and drinking fluids independently.

The perianal wound has a clean base with no extension; a moisture barrier cream was applied at Stage 2 and the surrounding maceration is improving. The provider asks the nurse to evaluate readiness for transition back to oral medications and to assess whether metformin can be restarted.

The daughter demonstrates correct donning and doffing of gown and gloves and performs hand hygiene with soap and water before and after the visit without prompting.
content.zh:
在过去的12小时内，排便频率已降至两次成形至半成形便。复查实验室指标：钾 3.8 mEq/L，肌酐 1.6 mg/dL，BUN 28 mg/dL，eGFR 33 mL/min/1.73 m²，乳酸 1.2 mmol/L，WBC 12.4 ×10³/µL。生命体征：体温 99 °F (37.2 °C)，心率 82，血压 118/72，呼吸 16，SpO₂ 98%。过去8小时的尿量为 400 mL（50 mL/hr）。患者正在吃软食并自主饮水。

肛周伤口基底干净，未见扩大；在阶段2应用了防潮隔离霜，周围的浸渍情况正在改善。医生要求护士评估是否已准备好过渡回口服药物，并评估是否可以重新开始使用二甲双胍。

女儿正确地演示了穿脱隔离衣和手套，并在探视前后主动用肥皂和水进行了手卫生。

stem.en: Based on the assessment findings and laboratory data at Stage 1, which physiological condition poses the most immediate threat to the patient?
stem.zh: 根据阶段1的评估结果和实验室数据，哪种生理状况对患者构成了最直接的威胁？

stem.en: At Stage 1, the nurse observes the daughter entering the room in gloves but no gown, and the son-in-law entering without any personal protective equipment. Which action should the nurse take immediately?
stem.zh: 在阶段1，护士观察到女儿戴着手套但未穿隔离衣进入病房，女婿未穿戴任何个人防护装备进入病房。护士应立即采取哪项行动？

stem.en: At Stage 2, the daughter asks the nurse if she can use hand sanitizer instead of washing her hands, and whether she needs to wear a gown and gloves if she is 'just sitting in the chair.' How should the nurse respond?
stem.zh: 在阶段2，女儿问护士是否可以使用免洗手消液代替洗手，以及如果她“只是坐在椅子上”，是否还需要穿隔离衣和戴手套。护士应如何回答？

stem.en: At Stage 2, the nurse assesses worsening perianal skin maceration and partial-thickness skin loss. Which intervention is the priority for protecting the patient's skin integrity?
stem.zh: 在阶段2，护士评估发现肛周皮肤浸渍加重并出现部分皮层缺失。为了保护患者的皮肤完整性，哪项干预措施是优先考虑的？

stem.en: At Stage 3, the nurse synthesizes the patient's data to evaluate the response to treatment. For each finding, determine if it indicates clinical improvement or requires ongoing monitoring.
stem.zh: 在阶段3，护士综合患者的数据以评估治疗反应。对于每一项发现，请判断它是否表明临床病情改善，或者是否需要持续监测。

rows.en: Stool frequency of two formed-to-semiformed stools in 12 hours
rows.zh: 12小时内排便两次，为成形至半成形便

rows.en: White blood cell (WBC) count decreasing from 18.2 ×10³/µL to 12.4 ×10³/µL
rows.zh: 白细胞 (WBC) 计数从 18.2 ×10³/µL 降至 12.4 ×10³/µL
eGFR 为 33 mL/min/1.73 m²（基线为 42）

correct.en: Decreased stool frequency, a dropping WBC count, restoring urine output, and a normal lactate level all indicate clinical improvement and positive response to treatment. However, an eGFR of 33 mL/min/1.73 m² remains below the patient's baseline of 42, indicating residual renal impairment that requires ongoing monitoring.
correct.zh: 排便频率降低、白细胞计数下降、尿量恢复以及乳酸水平正常均表明临床病情改善且对治疗有积极反应。然而，eGFR 为 33 mL/min/1.73 m² 仍低于患者的基线 42，表明存在残留的肾功能损害，需要持续监测。

byChoice.en: Decreased frequency and firmer consistency directly indicate the primary infection is resolving.
byChoice.zh: 频率降低和性状变硬直接表明原发感染正在消退。

byChoice.en: Although still mildly elevated, the downward trend from 18,200/µL is a clear sign of improvement.
byChoice.zh: 尽管仍有轻度升高，但从 18,200/µL 开始的下降趋势是明显的改善迹象。

byChoice.en: Renal function has not adequately recovered to baseline; this deficit requires ongoing monitoring before therapies like metformin can be safely resumed.
byChoice.zh: 肾功能尚未充分恢复至基线水平；在安全恢复二甲双胍等治疗之前，这种功能缺陷需要持续监测。

byChoice.en: Urine output >30 mL/hr confirms that renal perfusion has been restored.
byChoice.zh: 尿量 >30 mL/hr 证实肾灌注已恢复。

byChoice.en: Lactate dropping into the normal range indicates improved systemic tissue perfusion.
byChoice.zh: 乳酸降至正常范围表明全身组织灌注改善。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate outcomes by looking at the trend, not just the absolute number. A WBC dropping from 18,200 to 12,400 is an improving trend, even if it has not yet reached the normal range (<10,000).
testTakingStrategy.zh: 通过观察趋势而不仅仅是绝对数值来评估结果。即使尚未达到正常范围（<10,000），WBC 从 18,200 降至 12,400 也是一种改善的趋势。

stem.en: At Stage 3, the provider asks the nurse to evaluate whether the patient's home metformin should be restarted. The patient's eGFR is now 33 mL/min/1.73 m² (baseline 42). Which response by the nurse is the most appropriate?
stem.zh: 在阶段3，医生要求护士评估是否应重新开始使用患者居家服用的二甲双胍。患者目前的eGFR为 33 mL/min/1.73 m²（基线为42）。护士最恰当的回答是哪一项？

options.en: "Yes, we should resume it at the previous dose since the eGFR is trending upward."
options.zh: “是的，我们应该以先前的剂量恢复使用，因为eGFR呈现上升趋势。”

options.en: "I recommend holding it for now because the eGFR has not yet returned to her baseline and remains in a caution range."
options.zh: “我建议暂时停用，因为eGFR尚未恢复到她的基线水平，并且仍处于需要谨慎使用的范围内。”

options.en: "We can restart it, but we need to monitor her blood glucose closely for signs of hypoglycemia."
options.zh: “我们可以重新开始使用，但我们需要密切监测她的血糖，注意低血糖的迹象。”

options.en: "Metformin is permanently contraindicated now because her eGFR is below 45 mL/min/1.73 m²."
options.zh: “现在二甲双胍是永久禁忌的，因为她的eGFR低于 45 mL/min/1.73 m²。”

correct.en: Metformin carries a risk of lactic acidosis that increases with renal impairment. Although the eGFR has improved from 24 to 33 mL/min/1.73 m², it has not returned to her baseline of 42. Furthermore, an eGFR of 30-45 represents a caution range where dosage adjustment and close monitoring are required if initiated or continued. Restarting the medication while the patient is still recovering from acute kidney injury and dehydration is unsafe.
correct.zh: 二甲双胍具有引起乳酸酸中毒的风险，该风险随肾功能损害而增加。虽然eGFR已从24改善至 33 mL/min/1.73 m²，但尚未恢复到其基线水平42。此外，eGFR 30-45属于需要谨慎使用的范围，如果在该范围内开始或继续使用，需要调整剂量并密切监测。在患者仍从急性肾损伤和脱水中恢复时重新开始使用该药物是不安全的。

byChoice.en: An upward trend is positive, but the absolute value (33) and the failure to return to baseline indicate that renal function has not adequately recovered to safely clear full-dose metformin.
byChoice.zh: 上升趋势是积极的，但绝对值（33）以及未能恢复到基线表明，肾功能尚未充分恢复以安全清除全剂量的二甲双胍。

byChoice.en: Correct. Holding the medication is the safest approach until renal function approaches baseline and the patient is hemodynamically stable.
byChoice.zh: 正确。在肾功能接近基线且患者血流动力学稳定之前，暂停使用该药物是最安全的做法。

byChoice.en: The primary concern with metformin and renal impairment is lactic acidosis, not hypoglycemia. Restarting it at this point is inappropriate.
byChoice.zh: 二甲双胍和肾功能损害的主要问题是乳酸酸中毒，而不是低血糖。此时重新开始使用是不合适的。

byChoice.en: Metformin is generally contraindicated when eGFR is below 30 mL/min/1.73 m². At 30-45, it is not an absolute contraindication but requires dose review and caution.
byChoice.zh: 当eGFR低于 30 mL/min/1.73 m² 时，二甲双胍通常是禁忌使用的。在30-45之间，它不是绝对禁忌，但需要复核剂量并谨慎使用。

testTakingStrategy.en: Metformin and kidney disease: remember that poor renal function (especially eGFR < 30) increases the risk of lactic acidosis. Wait for renal recovery before resuming.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 二甲双胍与肾脏疾病：记住，不良的肾功能（特别是 eGFR < 30）会增加乳酸酸中毒的风险。在恢复肾功能之前应等待。

请查看病历记录并回答案例分析题。
Clostridioides difficile infection with dehydration and contact-precaution teaching for family visitors.
艰难梭菌感染伴脱水以及家属探视的接触隔离宣教。

A 71-year-old woman is transferred from a skilled nursing facility to a medical-surgical unit with a three-day history of profuse, watery, foul-smelling diarrhea. She completed a 10-day course of oral amoxicillin-clavulanate for community-acquired pneumonia six days ago. Her medical history includes type 2 diabetes managed with metformin 1,000 mg twice daily, hypertension treated with lisinopril 20 mg daily, osteoarthritis, and mild chronic kidney disease (baseline creatinine 1.4 mg/dL, baseline eGFR 42 mL/min/1.73 m²). She lives with her adult daughter and son-in-law, who visit daily and assist with meals and hygiene. On admission, the provider orders contact precautions, stool specimen for C. difficile toxin PCR, IV lactated Ringer's 500 mL bolus over 1 hour, then maintain at 125 mL/hr, strict intake and output, daily basic metabolic panel, and oral vancomycin 125 mg every 6 hours per facility protocol for suspected C. difficile infection. Metformin is held pending evaluation of renal function. A Braden scale assessment is ordered every shift.

一名71岁女性患者因连续3天出现大量水样、恶臭腹泻，从专业护理机构转入内外科病房。她于6天前完成了为期10天的口服阿莫西林-克拉维酸治疗社区获得性肺炎的疗程。既往病史包括2型糖尿病（规律服用二甲双胍1000 mg，每日两次）、高血压（规律服用赖诺普利20 mg，每日一次）、骨关节炎以及轻度慢性肾脏病（基线肌酐1.4 mg/dL，基线eGFR 42 mL/min/1.73 m²）。她与成年的女儿和女婿同住，他们每天来探视并协助进食和个人卫生。入院时，考虑到疑似艰难梭菌感染，医生下达医嘱：接触隔离，留取粪便标本行艰难梭菌毒素PCR检测，静脉输注乳酸林格氏液 500 mL 负荷量（1小时内滴完），随后以 125 mL/hr 维持，严格记录出入量，每日复查基础代谢指标（BMP），并根据机构方案给予口服万古霉素125 mg，每6小时一次。二甲双胍暂停使用，待评估肾功能后决定。每班进行一次Braden量表评估。

The patient reports six to eight loose, watery stools per day for the past three days, accompanied by diffuse crampy abdominal pain, poor oral intake, and increasing fatigue. She states she feels lightheaded when she stands and has not been eating well because "everything makes my stomach worse."

**Assessment Findings:** Temperature 100.6 °F (38.1 °C), heart rate 104, blood pressure 98/62, respiratory rate 18, SpO₂ 96% on room air. Weight 64 kg (documented weight two weeks ago was 68 kg). Mucous membranes dry and tacky, skin turgor sluggish over the sternum, capillary refill 3 seconds. Abdomen soft, diffusely tender without rebound or guarding; hyperactive bowel sounds. Perianal skin intact but erythematous. Braden score 15 (mild risk).

**Laboratory Data:** WBC 18.2 ×10³/µL, hemoglobin 13.8 g/dL, platelets 210 ×10³/µL. Sodium 139 mEq/L, potassium 3.3 mEq/L, chloride 96 mEq/L, bicarbonate 20 mEq/L, BUN 38 mg/dL, creatinine 2.1 mg/dL, eGFR 24 mL/min/1.73 m², glucose 188 mg/dL. Lactate 2.4 mmol/L. Albumin 2.8 g/dL. Stool C. difficile toxin PCR pending.

患者报告过去三天每天有6至8次稀水样便，伴有弥漫性痉挛性腹痛，进食差，疲劳感加重。她表示站立时感到头晕，并且因为“吃什么都让胃更难受”而没有好好进食。

**评估结果：** 体温 100.6 °F (38.1 °C)，心率 104，血压 98/62，呼吸频率 18，室内空气下SpO₂ 96%。体重 64 kg（两周前记录的体重为 68 kg）。黏膜干燥发粘，胸骨上方皮肤弹性迟缓，毛细血管充盈时间3秒。腹软，全腹弥漫性压痛，无反跳痛或肌紧张；肠鸣音活跃。肛周皮肤完整但有红斑。Braden量表评分 15分（轻度危险）。

**实验室数据：** WBC 18.2 ×10³/µL，血红蛋白 13.8 g/dL，血小板 210 ×10³/µL。钠 139 mEq/L，钾 3.3 mEq/L，氯 96 mEq/L，碳酸氢盐 20 mEq/L，BUN 38 mg/dL，肌酐 2.1 mg/dL，eGFR 24 mL/min/1.73 m²，葡萄糖 188 mg/dL。乳酸 2.4 mmol/L。白蛋白 2.8 g/dL。粪便艰难梭菌毒素PCR结果待报。

The C. difficile toxin PCR returns positive. The patient has had four more watery stools since admission. Intake: 1,400 mL IV fluids; output: 200 mL urine plus an estimated 1,200 mL stool. She remains tachycardic (HR 100) and hypotensive (BP 100/64). Repeat potassium drawn at 6 hours is 3.1 mEq/L. The provider is notified and orders IV potassium chloride 10 mEq in 100 mL normal saline over 1 hour via peripheral IV, repeat once; recheck potassium after replacement.

The patient's daughter and son-in-law arrive for their evening visit. The nurse observes the daughter enter the room wearing gloves but no gown, and the son-in-law follows her in without any personal protective equipment. The son-in-law picks up the bedside TV remote and then touches the patient's hand.

艰难梭菌毒素PCR结果呈阳性。自入院以来，患者又排了四次水样便。入量：1400 mL静脉输液；出量：200 mL尿液加上估计 1200 mL的粪便。她仍然表现为心动过速（心率 100）和低血压（血压 100/64）。入院后6小时复查的血钾为 3.1 mEq/L。已通知医生，医嘱要求通过外周静脉在1小时内静脉输注10 mEq氯化钾加入100 mL生理盐水中，重复一次；补钾后复查血钾。

患者的女儿和女婿晚上来探视。护士观察到女儿戴着手套但未穿隔离衣进入病房，女婿紧随其后进入，未穿戴任何个人防护装备（PPE）。女婿拿起病床旁的电视遥控器，然后摸了摸患者的手。

The patient's stool frequency has decreased to three episodes over the past 8 hours. Repeat labs: potassium 3.6 mEq/L (post-replacement), creatinine 1.9 mg/dL, BUN 34 mg/dL, lactate 1.8 mmol/L. Vitals: T 99.7 °F (37.6 °C), HR 92, BP 108/68, RR 16, SpO₂ 97%. Urine output over the past 8 hours is 280 mL. She is tolerating small sips of clear liquids.

The perianal erythema has worsened: the skin is now macerated with a shallow 1 cm × 0.5 cm area of partial-thickness skin loss at the 6-o'clock position. The Braden moisture subscale has dropped to 1 (constantly moist).

The daughter asks the nurse, "Can I just use hand sanitizer instead of washing my hands every time? It's faster." She also asks whether she needs to wear a gown and gloves when she is "just sitting in the chair and not touching Mom."

在过去的8小时内，患者的排便频率已降至三次。复查实验室指标：钾 3.6 mEq/L（补钾后），肌酐 1.9 mg/dL，BUN 34 mg/dL，乳酸 1.8 mmol/L。生命体征：体温 99.7 °F (37.6 °C)，心率 92，血压 108/68，呼吸 16，SpO₂ 97%。过去8小时的尿量为 280 mL。她能够耐受小口啜饮清流质饮食。

肛周红斑恶化：皮肤现在出现浸渍，在6点钟位置有一个 1 cm × 0.5 cm 的浅表部分皮层缺失区域。Braden量表的潮湿子项评分已降至1分（持续潮湿）。

女儿问护士：“我可以只用免洗手消液而不是每次都洗手吗？那样比较快。”她还问，如果她“只是坐在椅子上，不接触妈妈”，是否还需要穿隔离衣和戴手套。

Stool frequency is down to two formed-to-semiformed stools in the past 12 hours. Repeat labs: potassium 3.8 mEq/L, creatinine 1.6 mg/dL, BUN 28 mg/dL, eGFR 33 mL/min/1.73 m², lactate 1.2 mmol/L, WBC 12.4 ×10³/µL. Vitals: T 99 °F (37.2 °C), HR 82, BP 118/72, RR 16, SpO₂ 98%. Urine output over the past 8 hours is 400 mL (50 mL/hr). The patient is eating a soft diet and drinking fluids independently.

The perianal wound has a clean base with no extension; a moisture barrier cream was applied at Stage 2 and the surrounding maceration is improving. The provider asks the nurse to evaluate readiness for transition back to oral medications and to assess whether metformin can be restarted.

The daughter demonstrates correct donning and doffing of gown and gloves and performs hand hygiene with soap and water before and after the visit without prompting.

在过去的12小时内，排便频率已降至两次成形至半成形便。复查实验室指标：钾 3.8 mEq/L，肌酐 1.6 mg/dL，BUN 28 mg/dL，eGFR 33 mL/min/1.73 m²，乳酸 1.2 mmol/L，WBC 12.4 ×10³/µL。生命体征：体温 99 °F (37.2 °C)，心率 82，血压 118/72，呼吸 16，SpO₂ 98%。过去8小时的尿量为 400 mL（50 mL/hr）。患者正在吃软食并自主饮水。

肛周伤口基底干净，未见扩大；在阶段2应用了防潮隔离霜，周围的浸渍情况正在改善。医生要求护士评估是否已准备好过渡回口服药物，并评估是否可以重新开始使用二甲双胍。

女儿正确地演示了穿脱隔离衣和手套，并在探视前后主动用肥皂和水进行了手卫生。
Based on the assessment findings and laboratory data at Stage 1, which physiological condition poses the most immediate threat to the patient?
根据阶段1的评估结果和实验室数据，哪种生理状况对患者构成了最直接的威胁？

At Stage 1, the nurse observes the daughter entering the room in gloves but no gown, and the son-in-law entering without any personal protective equipment. Which action should the nurse take immediately?
在阶段1，护士观察到女儿戴着手套但未穿隔离衣进入病房，女婿未穿戴任何个人防护装备进入病房。护士应立即采取哪项行动？

At Stage 2, the daughter asks the nurse if she can use hand sanitizer instead of washing her hands, and whether she needs to wear a gown and gloves if she is 'just sitting in the chair.' How should the nurse respond?
在阶段2，女儿问护士是否可以使用免洗手消液代替洗手，以及如果她“只是坐在椅子上”，是否还需要穿隔离衣和戴手套。护士应如何回答？
At Stage 2, the nurse assesses worsening perianal skin maceration and partial-thickness skin loss. Which intervention is the priority for protecting the patient's skin integrity?
在阶段2，护士评估发现肛周皮肤浸渍加重并出现部分皮层缺失。为了保护患者的皮肤完整性，哪项干预措施是优先考虑的？

At Stage 3, the provider asks the nurse to evaluate whether the patient's home metformin should be restarted. The patient's eGFR is now 33 mL/min/1.73 m² (baseline 42). Which response by the nurse is the most appropriate?
在阶段3，医生要求护士评估是否应重新开始使用患者居家服用的二甲双胍。患者目前的eGFR为 33 mL/min/1.73 m²（基线为42）。护士最恰当的回答是哪一项？
"Yes, we should resume it at the previous dose since the eGFR is trending upward."
“是的，我们应该以先前的剂量恢复使用，因为eGFR呈现上升趋势。”
"I recommend holding it for now because the eGFR has not yet returned to her baseline and remains in a caution range."
“我建议暂时停用，因为eGFR尚未恢复到她的基线水平，并且仍处于需要谨慎使用的范围内。”
"We can restart it, but we need to monitor her blood glucose closely for signs of hypoglycemia."
“我们可以重新开始使用，但我们需要密切监测她的血糖，注意低血糖的迹象。”
"Metformin is permanently contraindicated now because her eGFR is below 45 mL/min/1.73 m²."
“现在二甲双胍是永久禁忌的，因为她的eGFR低于 45 mL/min/1.73 m²。”
An upward trend is positive, but the absolute value (33) and the failure to return to baseline indicate that renal function has not adequately recovered to safely clear full-dose metformin.
上升趋势是积极的，但绝对值（33）以及未能恢复到基线表明，肾功能尚未充分恢复以安全清除全剂量的二甲双胍。
Correct. Holding the medication is the safest approach until renal function approaches baseline and the patient is hemodynamically stable.
正确。在肾功能接近基线且患者血流动力学稳定之前，暂停使用该药物是最安全的做法。
The primary concern with metformin and renal impairment is lactic acidosis, not hypoglycemia. Restarting it at this point is inappropriate.
二甲双胍和肾功能损害的主要问题是乳酸酸中毒，而不是低血糖。此时重新开始使用是不合适的。
Metformin is generally contraindicated when eGFR is below 30 mL/min/1.73 m². At 30-45, it is not an absolute contraindication but requires dose review and caution.
当eGFR低于 30 mL/min/1.73 m² 时，二甲双胍通常是禁忌使用的。在30-45之间，它不是绝对禁忌，但需要复核剂量并谨慎使用。

Metformin carries a risk of lactic acidosis that increases with renal impairment. Although the eGFR has improved from 24 to 33 mL/min/1.73 m², it has not returned to her baseline of 42. Furthermore, an eGFR of 30-45 represents a caution range where dosage adjustment and close monitoring are required if initiated or continued. Restarting the medication while the patient is still recovering from acute kidney injury and dehydration is unsafe.
二甲双胍具有引起乳酸酸中毒的风险，该风险随肾功能损害而增加。虽然eGFR已从24改善至 33 mL/min/1.73 m²，但尚未恢复到其基线水平42。此外，eGFR 30-45属于需要谨慎使用的范围，如果在该范围内开始或继续使用，需要调整剂量并密切监测。在患者仍从急性肾损伤和脱水中恢复时重新开始使用该药物是不安全的。
Metformin and kidney disease: remember that poor renal function (especially eGFR < 30) increases the risk of lactic acidosis. Wait for renal recovery before resuming.
二甲双胍与肾脏疾病：记住，不良的肾功能（特别是 eGFR < 30）会增加乳酸酸中毒的风险。在恢复肾功能之前应等待。
At Stage 3, the nurse synthesizes the patient's data to evaluate the response to treatment. For each finding, determine if it indicates clinical improvement or requires ongoing monitoring.
在阶段3，护士综合患者的数据以评估治疗反应。对于每一项发现，请判断它是否表明临床病情改善，或者是否需要持续监测。
Stool frequency of two formed-to-semiformed stools in 12 hours
12小时内排便两次，为成形至半成形便
White blood cell (WBC) count decreasing from 18.2 ×10³/µL to 12.4 ×10³/µL
白细胞 (WBC) 计数从 18.2 ×10³/µL 降至 12.4 ×10³/µL
eGFR 为 33 mL/min/1.73 m²（基线为 42）
Decreased frequency and firmer consistency directly indicate the primary infection is resolving.
频率降低和性状变硬直接表明原发感染正在消退。
Although still mildly elevated, the downward trend from 18,200/µL is a clear sign of improvement.
尽管仍有轻度升高，但从 18,200/µL 开始的下降趋势是明显的改善迹象。
Renal function has not adequately recovered to baseline; this deficit requires ongoing monitoring before therapies like metformin can be safely resumed.
肾功能尚未充分恢复至基线水平；在安全恢复二甲双胍等治疗之前，这种功能缺陷需要持续监测。
Urine output >30 mL/hr confirms that renal perfusion has been restored.
尿量 >30 mL/hr 证实肾灌注已恢复。
Lactate dropping into the normal range indicates improved systemic tissue perfusion.
乳酸降至正常范围表明全身组织灌注改善。

Decreased stool frequency, a dropping WBC count, restoring urine output, and a normal lactate level all indicate clinical improvement and positive response to treatment. However, an eGFR of 33 mL/min/1.73 m² remains below the patient's baseline of 42, indicating residual renal impairment that requires ongoing monitoring.
排便频率降低、白细胞计数下降、尿量恢复以及乳酸水平正常均表明临床病情改善且对治疗有积极反应。然而，eGFR 为 33 mL/min/1.73 m² 仍低于患者的基线 42，表明存在残留的肾功能损害，需要持续监测。
Evaluate outcomes by looking at the trend, not just the absolute number. A WBC dropping from 18,200 to 12,400 is an improving trend, even if it has not yet reached the normal range (<10,000).
通过观察趋势而不仅仅是绝对数值来评估结果。即使尚未达到正常范围（<10,000），WBC 从 18,200 降至 12,400 也是一种改善的趋势。

stem.en: Read the case study and answer the questions that follow.
stem.zh: 阅读案例研究并回答以下问题。

title.en: Advance directive clarification and code status escalation in metastatic lung cancer with acute respiratory decline.
title.zh: 伴有急性呼吸衰退的转移性肺癌中的预立医疗指示澄清和抢救状态升级。

summary.en: Mr. Harold Jeffries is a 55-year-old man admitted five days ago to a medical-surgical unit with progressive dyspnea and right-sided pleural effusion secondary to metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (stage IV). He is receiving palliative carboplatin-based chemotherapy. Current orders include supplemental oxygen via nasal cannula titrated to maintain SpO₂ > 92%. The attending is a pulmonologist currently in the OR; the covering provider is a hospitalist. The medical record contains no advance directive, POLST, or healthcare power of attorney. The code status is 'Full Code' (default). His daughter Keisha is the emergency contact. At 0700, he states unprompted: 'I've been thinking about this all night. I don't want to be kept alive by machines. If something happens, I don't want them to put a tube down my throat... I just want to be comfortable.'
summary.zh: Harold Jeffries 先生是一位 55 岁的男性，五天前因转移性非小细胞肺癌（IV期）继发的进行性呼吸困难和右侧胸腔积液收治于内外科病房。他正在接受以卡铂为基础的姑息性化疗。目前的医嘱包括通过鼻导管吸氧以维持 SpO₂ > 92%。主治医生是目前在手术室的呼吸科医生；代班医生是住院医师。病历中没有预立医疗指示、维持生命治疗医生医嘱（POLST）或医疗委托书。抢救状态为“全面抢救 (Full Code)”（默认）。他的女儿 Keisha 是紧急联系人。在 0700，他自发地说道：“我整晚都在想这件事。我不想靠机器维持生命。如果发生什么事，我不想他们把管子插进我喉咙里……我只想舒舒服服的。”

title.zh: 初步评估与实验室检查 (0700)

content.en:
Vital Signs:
Temperature: 98.8 °F (37.1 °C)
Heart rate: 92 bpm
Blood pressure: 118/72 mmHg
Respiratory rate: 20 breaths/min
SpO₂: 93% on 3 L nasal cannula

Assessment:
Alert, oriented to person, place, time, situation.
Conversational, assesses with full decision-making capacity.
Respirations mildly labored with accessory muscle use at rest.
Diminished breath sounds over right lower/middle lung fields.
Scattered expiratory wheezes in left lung.
Pain: 3/10, right-sided chest wall ache.
Speaks in full sentences.

Labs (0530):
WBC: 3.8 ×10³/µL
Hemoglobin: 10.4 g/dL
Platelets: 112 ×10³/µL
BUN: 18 mg/dL
Creatinine: 0.9 mg/dL
Albumin: 2.6 g/dL
LDH: 680 U/L
content.zh:
生命体征：
体温：98.8 °F (37.1 °C)
心率：92 次/分
血压：118/72 mmHg
呼吸频率：20 次/分
SpO₂：3 L鼻导管吸氧下 93%

评估：
清醒，对人物、地点、时间和情况定向力良好。
能够交谈，经评估具有完全的决策能力。
静息时呼吸轻度费力，伴有辅助呼吸肌参与。
右下/中肺野呼吸音减弱。
左肺散在呼气相哮鸣音。
疼痛：3/10，右侧胸壁钝痛。
能说完整的句子。

实验室检查 (0530)：
白细胞：3.8 ×10³/µL
血红蛋白：10.4 g/dL
血小板：112 ×10³/µL
尿素氮：18 mg/dL
肌酐：0.9 mg/dL
白蛋白：2.6 g/dL
乳酸脱氢酶：680 U/L

content.en: After Mr. Jeffries clarifies he does not want endotracheal intubation, mechanical ventilation, or CPR (but accepts oxygen and comfort meds), the nurse documents his verbatim statements and capacity. At 0745, the attending's office states he is scrubbing for a case and unavailable until 1400. The covering hospitalist, Dr. Reeves, is paged and responds at 0800: 'I am rounding on the other side of the hospital. I'll see him around 1100.' The code status remains Full Code.
content.zh: 在 Jeffries 先生明确表示他不希望进行气管插管、机械通气或心肺复苏（但接受吸氧和舒适药物）后，护士记录了他的原话及其决策能力。在 0745，主治医生的办公室表示他正在为手术刷手，直到 1400 才有空。代班住院医师 Reeves 医生被呼叫，并在 0800 回复：“我正在医院另一边查房。我大概 1100 会去看他。”抢救状态仍然是全面抢救 (Full Code)。

content.en:
At 0930, portable CXR shows a large recurrent right-sided pleural effusion with mediastinal shift and a new left pleural effusion.
At 0945, patient becomes acutely dyspneic. SpO₂ 88% on 3 L. Nurse increases O₂ to 6 L face mask; SpO₂ improves to 90%. 
At 0950, nurse pages Dr. Reeves about the acute respiratory failure and wishes against intubation. Dr. Reeves replies he will come 'as soon as I can.'
At 1030, SpO₂ is 89% on 6 L face mask, RR 30, HR 118, BP 102/64. Patient says between breaths: 'Please... don't let them... put a tube in me.' Nurse switches to non-rebreather mask at 15 L/min; SpO₂ rises to 91%.
content.zh:
在 0930，床旁胸片显示右侧胸腔积液大量复发伴纵隔移位，并出现新的左侧胸腔积液。
在 0945，患者出现急性呼吸困难。3 L吸氧下 SpO₂ 为 88%。护士将氧气增加到 6 L 面罩；SpO₂ 升至 90%。

options.en: A recommendation that the RRT stand down because the patient has verbally refused treatment.

options.en: A request for the RRT nurse to immediately administer procedural sedation for intubation.

stem.en: At 1130, after the DNAR/DNI order is entered, which actions evaluate the effectiveness of the advocacy process? Select all that apply.

options.en: Notifying the healthcare proxy of the clinical deterioration and advance directive.

options.en: Filing an incident report regarding the system vulnerability caused by the delayed provider response.
options.zh: 针对因医生延迟回复而引起的系统漏洞提交事件报告。

options.en: Writing a single retrospective note at the end of the shift summarizing the events.

byChoice.en: Visual identifiers are essential fail-safes during emergencies.
byChoice.zh: 视觉标识是紧急情况下的基本失效保护机制。

byChoice.en: Reporting system-level gaps is vital for institutional quality improvement and future patient safety.

byChoice.en: The proxy must be aware of the patient's condition and the updated care plan.
